# PCMag

> > PCMag is a leading technology publication providing expert reviews, buying guides, and how-to content for consumer electronics, software, and digital services.

PCMag delivers comprehensive testing and analysis of desktop computers, browsers, mobile devices, and networking equipment. The site features hands-on reviews of products from major technology companies including Microsoft, Google, Apple, and Acer, along with practical troubleshooting guides for connectivity and device issues.

## Key Topics

- Desktop Computers & PCs
- Web Browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Opera, Safari)
- Internet Troubleshooting & Connectivity
- Windows & Android Operating Systems
- Network Diagnostics & Speed Testing
- Mobile Signal Strength
- Browser Comparisons & Reviews
- ISP & Connection Issues
- Android Emulation on PC
- Technology Product Reviews
- Buying Guides & Best Picks
- Expert Testing Methodology
- Consumer Electronics
- Software & Applications

## Product Reviews & Buying Guides

- [The Best PCs (Desktop Computers) We've Tested for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/the-best-desktop-computers?test_uuid=04IpBmWGZleS0I0J3epvMrC&test_variant=A): Tested desktop PC reviews & buying guide featuring Acer & Windows systems
- [Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Opera, or Safari? We Pick the Best Browser for 2026](https://www.pcmag.com/picks/chrome-edge-firefox-opera-or-safari-we-pick-the-best-browser): Browser comparison reviewing Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Opera & Safari for 2026

## Troubleshooting & Technical Guides

- [An Expert's Guide to Fixing Your Spotty Internet and Getting Back Online](https://www.pcmag.com/explainers/12-tips-to-troubleshoot-your-internet-connection): Expert guide to troubleshoot internet issues using Speedtest.net & more
- [8 Ways to Improve Your Phone's Signal Strength](https://www.pcmag.com/how-to/how-to-improve-mobile-signal-strength): Guide to fix mobile signal issues on iPhone & Android devices

## How-To Tutorials

- [Want to Run Android Apps, Games on Your PC? Try These 5 Programs](https://www.pcmag.com/how-to/3-free-ways-to-run-android-apps-on-your-pc): Tutorial for running Android apps on Windows PC using emulators & tools
